The club

More than
a boxing gym.

Rob Roy is a community amateur boxing club based at 567 Broomfield Road, Springburn, in the former All Saints Church. It is affiliated to Boxing Scotland, the sport’s governing body in Scotland — so members train in a real, recognised club, not a fitness fad.

Here you learn proper boxing — footwork, guard, punching and ring craft — and you build fitness, discipline and confidence alongside it. Juniors train beside seniors, neighbours train beside neighbours, and everyone is welcome from age 10 upwards.

Your coach

Coached by
people who know boxing.

Head Coach — Boxing Scotland Directory

James Lyon

Head Coach, Rob Roy Boxing Club

Rob Roy’s head coach leads the club’s junior and senior sessions. And the club’s pedigree runs deep: Rob Roy boxer Isa Akram won bronze at the European Junior Championships in 2019 and gold at the Monkstown Box Cup — proof of what a Springburn club can produce.

The Rob Roy way

Proud of
where we come from.

Rob Roy carries one of Glasgow’s great boxing names. The club has been part of Springburn life for generations — and its boxers have gone on to represent Scotland, winning medals at European level.

  • A Boxing Scotland affiliated amateur club
  • Junior and senior boxing from age 10 to adult
  • Box fitness, ladies’ classes, bootcamp & personal training
  • Based in the former All Saints Church, Broomfield Road
